bio: I'm a graphic designer working across branding, packaging, illustration and signage, with a painting practice on the side. I like projects that start with a mark and then have to work on every surface it touches: a label, a box, a lobby wall, a banner.
I also draw production-ready shop drawings, so my designs come with the dimensions, materials and mounting details needed to build them.
